text:
tara: quick heads-up — running an initial smoke + latency sweep for perigee-7b on staging. seeing some OOM-ish allocator failures at 2k tokens when using q4_0. can someone spare a bench GPU?

ev an: @tara i can spin up a slot on bench-runner-12 in ~5m. what profile do you want? default 2048/64 batch?

tara: yes default is fine, but pls enable kv-cache warmup and prefix caching. also leave logging at DEBUG for first run.

evan: queued job id 8472 on bench-runner-12, GPU A100-80G. ETA 4m.

ops-bot: Job 8472 accepted. env: staging, model: perigee-7b-q4_0, tokens=2048, batch=64, cache=on. ETA: 4min.

jj: fyi CI smoke earlier failed with this stack, might be related to tiled attention fallback: ```
RuntimeError: failed to allocate memory for KV cache
  File "/app/runtime/core.py", line 412, in forward
    cache.alloc(size)
  File "/app/runtime/cache.py", line 78, in alloc
    raise OOMError("allocator: could not satisfy request")
```

ana: @jj thanks — can you paste the model config used in CI? need to check tiling/stride params.

jj: CI used config: `seq_len=2048, kv_tiling=128, tile_overlap=16, qk_dtype=float16`. attaching minimal diff in comments.

maria: quick thought — q4_0 sometimes underreports working set on A100 when using 2‑way tensor split. try a single-device run with same FP fallback to rule out split bug.

evan: job 8472 started. baseline latency (end-to-end) for 64 batch, 512 prompt: p50=42ms, p95=118ms, token throughput ~11.2k tok/s. no OOM at 512.

 tara: can you ramp to 2k tokens now?

evan: ramping. ran 3 samples at 2k: first attempt failed with same alloc error on step 2. captured profiler snippet: ```trace
ALLOCATOR: peak 63.4GB
REQUEST: 8.1GB
ACTION: fallback to disk-swap? false
STACK: runtime/cache.py:78 -> core.py:412
```

maria: that peak seems high. what quant backend and kernel set selected?

evan: kernel selection: xformers-tiling-v2, matmul-kernel=auto, quant-backend=custom-q4-uvm.

ana: can you try `kv_tiling=64` and `tile_overlap=8`? reduces transient working set. also try `--force-single-device` flag.

evan: reran with those changes + single-device. completed 2k token run: p50=68ms, p95=340ms, throughput 7.1k tok/s. memory peak 46.8GB. no OOM.

jj: good repro steps for CI: bump tiling down and pin single-device in the smoke. i'll open a PR to adjust the flaky test.

tara: nice — can we publish a short summary for the onboarding doc? core items: default q4_0 + 2-way split causes intermittents at 2k tokens; recommended config for staging/hosted: `kv_tiling=64, tile_overlap=8, force_single_device=true`; perf: p50 68ms @512 prompt/64 batch, p95 340ms @2k tokens; throughput 7.1k tok/s @2k.

maria: add note: if customers need >2k tokens at q4_0, recommend q5_1 or full fp16.

ana: PR #4127 created to relax CI smoke and document the recommended flags. linking bench logs here: https://internal.redwood/bench/8472/logs

evan: tagging @eng-sre for follow-up on allocator metrics and whether we should expose a QA check for transient peaks. :search: 

tara: thanks all — publishing results to onboarding folder now and cc-ing product for rollout notes. :thumbsup:
